title: Display active AGV paths on Map Monitor using “View all AGV active paths” icon
summary: Use the Map Monitor Quick Select panel to visualize all active AGV routes on the map as small blue lines from each AGV to its destination, so you can confirm what each AGV is currently trying to reach.
when_to_use: When you need to quickly see every AGV’s currently active route on the Map Monitor (e.g., to understand where AGVs are headed based on their active paths).
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Map Monitor Quick Select action and verify the expected blue-line route visualization on the map.
access_or_tools_needed: Quick Select panel icons (specifically “View all AGV active paths”)

visual_references.description: Map Monitor Quick Select panel showing the “View all AGV active paths” icon and related icons.

steps.title: Open the Map Monitor screen that contains the Quick Select icons
steps.purpose: Get to the correct Map Monitor UI area where the Quick Select icons are available.
steps.instruction: Open the Map Monitor screen that includes the Quick Select panel with the icon “View all AGV active paths.”
steps.expected_result: The Quick Select panel with the “View all AGV active paths” icon is visible.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Quick Select icons panel (including “View all AGV active paths”).
steps.failure_condition: The Quick Select panel (or the “View all AGV active paths” icon) is not visible on the screen you opened.

actions.label: Verify Quick Select panel is present
actions.exact_action: Open the Map Monitor screen that contains the Quick Select icons.

steps.title: Click the “View all AGV active paths” icon in the Quick Select panel
steps.purpose: Trigger the map overlay that displays all active AGV paths.
steps.instruction: In the Quick Select panel, click the “View all AGV active paths” icon.
steps.expected_result: The map updates to show all active AGV paths.
steps.healthy_condition: After clicking, the map displays active paths for the AGVs.
steps.failure_condition: After clicking, the map does not show the expected active-path visualization.

actions.label: Show all active AGV paths
actions.exact_action: Click the “View all AGV active paths” icon in the Quick Select panel.

steps.title: Verify active paths appear as small blue lines from each AGV to its destination
steps.purpose: Confirm the visualization matches the expected behavior for active AGV routing.
steps.instruction: On the map, verify that active paths appear as small blue lines starting from each AGV and ending at where the AGV wants to go.
steps.expected_result: The map shows all active AGV paths as small blue lines from each AGV to its destination.
steps.healthy_condition: You can visually identify small blue lines on the map that start at AGV positions and end at the intended destination locations for those AGVs.
steps.failure_condition: No small blue lines appear for active AGV paths after selecting “View all AGV active paths.”

actions.label: Check for blue route lines
actions.exact_action: On the map, verify that active paths appear as small blue lines starting from each AGV and ending at where the AGV wants to go.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the expected blue lines do not appear, stop and escalate for support (the source does not provide troubleshooting steps for missing paths).

success_criteria: Map Monitor displays active AGV paths as small blue lines from each AGV to its destination after clicking “View all AGV active paths.”
healthy_conditions: Small blue lines are visible on the map representing active routes from AGVs to their intended destinations.
failure_conditions: No blue lines appear after selecting “View all AGV active paths.”
escalation_guidance: If the expected blue lines do not appear, stop and escalate for support because the source only describes the display behavior and does not provide remediation steps for missing paths.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Quick Select panel icon “View all AGV active paths” (and related icons) used to display active AGV paths.

missing_details: The source does not provide troubleshooting/remediation steps for the case where no blue active-path lines appear after clicking “View all AGV active paths.”
